newsitem.title: USA: Foamex sees Q1 EPS in range of $0.29-$0.33.
newsitem.headline: Foamex sees Q1 EPS in range of $0.29-$0.33.

text.p: Foamex International Inc said Monday that preliminary estimates for the first quarter of 1997 indicate earnings per share would be between $0.29 and $0.33, which is the range of analysts' estimates published by First Call.
The company said it expects to announce first quarter results on or about April 23.
The company also said it has initiated an evaluation of its current capital structure, with the intention of reducing interest expense and improving financing flexibility.
As of December 29, 1996, long-term debt was about $483.0 million, the company said.
Foamex said it reduced long-term debt by more than 30 percent last year.
